hints.title: Subtree Root Matching Obstacle
hints.text: Subtree matching requires identical structure and node values from some starting point downward. How can checking tree equality at every candidate node determine if any subtree matches the target?

hints.title: Exact Structural Identity Invariant
hints.text: A tree contains subRoot if the tree itself is identical to subRoot or if subRoot is a subtree of either the left or right branch.

hints.title: Dual DFS Validation Procedure
hints.text: Write a helper isSameTree(s, t). If root is null, return false. If isSameTree(root, subRoot) is true, return true. Otherwise, return the logical OR of isSubtree on root.left and root.right.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Checking tree equality of size M at each of the N potential subtree roots in worst-case O(N * M) time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing in-order traversals alone fails because non-isomorphic trees can have identical in-order sequences without null markers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Using a dedicated isSameTree helper rather than approximate hashing.
